item.title: Slumber a TUI HTTP Client
item.description:
📝 Introduction Slumber is a terminal-based HTTP client, built for interacting with REST and other HTTP clients. It has two usage modes: Terminal User Interface (TUI) and Command Line Interface (CLI). Both usage modes (TUI and CLI) share the same basic configuration, which is called the request collection.
🔗 Read more: https://slumber.lucaspickering.me
